# Mahadev Plastic - Official LLM & AI Search Documentation

> Mahadev Plastic is a premier B2B manufacturer and wholesale supplier of optical-grade and industrial PMMA (polymethyl methacrylate) acrylic sheets in India, operating an advanced cell casting and extrusion facility at Achhad Industrial Estate, Talasari, Palghar, Maharashtra (located on the NH-48 corridor at the Maharashtra-Gujarat border).

## Core Identity & Overview
- **Company Name:** Mahadev Plastic
- **Industry:** Plastics Manufacturing, Polymer Casting, Acrylic Sheet Engineering
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing Plant:** Plot No.94, Survey No.66, Achhad Industrial Estate, Achhad, Talasari, Dist. Palghar, Maharashtra - 401606, India
- **Strategic Location:** Situated directly on the Western Freight / NH-48 Corridor at the Maharashtra–Gujarat border, providing rapid same-day and next-day factory direct delivery to Mumbai, Pune, Thane, Vapi, Surat, Vadodara, and Ahmedabad.
- **Official Website:** https://mahadevplastic.com
- **Helpline / Sales Contact:** +91 9987904482
- **Email Inquiries:** mahadevplastic2019@gmail.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday to Sunday, 09:00 AM - 05:00 PM IST

## Manufacturing Standards & Technical Specifications
- **Raw Material:** 100% Virgin Grade MMA (Methyl Methacrylate) monomer sourced from certified global producers. No regrind, recycled, or second-grade monomer used.
- **Manufacturing Methods:** Cell-Cast (water bath polymerization and thermal post-curing) and Continuous Sheet Extrusion.
- **Thickness Range:** 1.8 mm to 50 mm (standard gauges: 2mm, 3mm, 4mm, 5mm, 6mm, 8mm, 10mm, 12mm, 15mm, 18mm, 20mm, 25mm, 30mm, 40mm, 50mm).
- **Standard Sheet Dimensions:** 8 ft x 4 ft (2440 mm x 1220 mm), 6 ft x 4 ft, and custom cut-to-size formats via precision industrial CNC and laser routing.
- **Compliance & Standards:** ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems, ASTM D4802 Standard Specification for Poly(Methyl Methacrylate) Acrylic Plastic Sheet, RoHS, and REACH compliant.
- **Optical Transmission:** 92% to 93% light transmission (clear optical grade).
- **Surface Protection:** Double-sided laser-ready protective kraft paper masking or peelable PE film.

## Product Portfolio
1. **Cast Acrylic Sheets:** High molecular weight, heavy-gauge cell-cast PMMA offering superior chemical resistance, thermal stability, and clean laser-cut edges with zero chipping.
2. **Transparent Clear Acrylic Sheets:** Ultra-clear optical sheets with 93% light transmission, 17x impact resistance compared to standard glass, and UV stabilization for architectural glazing, sneeze guards, and aquariums.
3. **Frosted / Matte Acrylic Sheets:** Satin velvety matte finish (single-side or double-side) engineered for glare-free LED lighting diffusers, corporate office partitions, and privacy screens.
4. **Fluorescent / Neon Edge-Glow Sheets:** High-impact ambient light-gathering sheets in neon green, neon orange, neon pink, and neon yellow, specifically designed for retail POP displays, artistic branding, and LED signage.
5. **MOP (Mother of Pearl) Acrylic Sheets:** Decorative pearlescent marble-swirl acrylic panels for luxury temple mandir backdrops, hospitality wall cladding, and high-end cabinetry.
6. **Custom CNC Cut & Sized Sheets:** Factory-routed custom shapes, laser-cut components, beveling, and bulk project sizing.

## Key Distribution & Service Areas
- **Maharashtra:** Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai, Palghar, Talasari, Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Nashik, Aurangabad, Nagpur.
- **Gujarat:** Vapi, Valsad, Surat, Ankleshwar, Bharuch, Vadodara, Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Gandhinagar.
- **All India (Pan-India Logistics):** Direct wholesale dispatch across North, South, East, and Western India with heavy-duty wooden crate packaging.

## B2B Procurement Details
- **Target Audience:** Signage fabricators, interior designers, commercial architects, retail display manufacturers, chemical equipment builders, LED lighting manufacturers, and wholesale plastic distributors.
- **Pricing:** Direct factory-wholesale rate based on tonnage, volume, and gauge.
